data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate strengthened technical reserves by $229k in respect of prior periods (2017: release of $267k) arising predominantly from the Property Division. The strengthening was due to adverse claims development on prior year losses during 2018.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (1 January 2018) was $8.965m. During 2018 the syndicate strengthened prior year reserves by $0.229m (a 2.55% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding), arising predominantly in the Property division due to adverse development on prior year losses.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2018 the Syndicate strengthened technical reserves by $229k in respect of prior periods (2017: release of $267k) arising predominantly from the Property Division.
The strengthening was due to adverse claims development on prior year losses during 2018.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are taken from the report which presents values in USD $'000. Values in this JSON are converted to millions (divide $'000 by 1,000). Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position 'Claims outstanding' (prior year comparative column 2017 = $8,965k). Prior year movement taken from Note '4. Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a $229k strengthening; the note is presented as a gross amount in narrative and has been used as the gross prior-year development. Segmental premium breakdown used is the 'Reinsurance acceptances' divisional table (Energy, Property, Political Risks & Political Violence, Liability, Marine, Aviation). The Marine entry shows a small negative premium in the table (-$6k) which is included as -0.006m. No specific named catastrophe events are listed in the text. Confidence levels reflect explicit figures (1.0) or inference where allocation to an LOB is described but not quantified (0.5).
